answer: Reputation is discounted by an exponential temporal half-life, so influence fades unless an identity sustains honest, reciprocal service over time. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has little trusted incoming mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture that history, keeping it below consensus thresholds. Names such as umber, karst, or jade confer no trust.
